configurator.title: This is the configurator. Try it now.
configurator.subtitle: This is the demo of the configurator your customers find on your site: they configure the window, see the price and you receive a complete request. On your site it uses your price list and your brand.

valueProp.title: Every day you lose time on requests that go nowhere
valueProp.body: Curiosity calls, pointless site visits, competitors posing as customers just to undercut you on price. onespec puts a configurator between you and these requests: whoever reaches you has already figured out the product and the budget.

features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't

items.title: Filters out anyone who isn't a real buyer
items.description: No more wasting time on people who only want to compare prices to undercut you. The configurator qualifies the request before it reaches you.

items.title: Prices close to reality
items.description: Configurable pricing rules for materials, sizes and finishes: the quote the customer sees is almost the final one.

items.title: Instant updates
items.description: You update the configurator from the onespec platform: changes go live on every site where it's installed, immediately.

items.title: Two-tone: outside different from inside
items.description: Pick one finish for the outer face and another for the inner, with correct price and drawing in the widget, wizard, Showroom, quote and PDF.

items.title: Leads and final quotes
items.description: Import lists from Excel, CSV or Word, turn them into clients and job sites, and keep the final-quote PDF in the client record.

items.title: Secure and ready to try
items.description: Sign-up with age check and DPA, verified uploads, signed webhooks. And you can try the whole platform in demo, no account needed.

dashboard.title: Quotes come in, you see them in real time
dashboard.subtitle: Every configurator request shows up at once on the Requests page, with customer, contact details, value and status: filter it, open it and follow it through to the quote.

pricing.title: Choose the plan that fits you
pricing.subtitle: From the quote tool on your site to the complete platform: all plans and prices are on the dedicated page.

cta.title: Bring onespec to your website today
cta.subtitle: Sign up, pick a plan and publish your configurator. Secure payment with Stripe, cancel any time.

iframeExplainer.title: What's an iFrame code?
iframeExplainer.subtitle: It's the technical part of onespec, and it's the only one. No developer needed, nothing on your existing site gets touched.

points.title: It's a window inside your site
points.body: The iFrame shows an external page inside one of your pages. Visitors see the configurator as if it were part of your site: no page change, no leaving you.

points.title: You paste it once
points.body: Copy the code and paste it wherever you want the configurator to appear. Works with WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow or a hand-built site: it's standard HTML.

points.title: It updates itself
points.body: The content lives on our servers. When you change the price list or colors from the platform, the code on your site stays identical and the configurator is already updated.

iframeExplainer.footnote: Only one line changes from customer to customer: <id>tuo-id</id>. Everything else is identical for everyone.

changelog.title: Promotion codes on monthly billing
items: New «Promotion codes» section in the Terms of service: one code per customer, first monthly invoice only, not valid for Enterprise or yearly billing, not combinable with the invite discount
Yearly checkout no longer shows the promotion code field
Invite programme: a first payment reduced by a promotion code does not earn the reward, which is earned from the next full-price payment

changelog.title: Invite programme in line with tax rules
items: Invite rules completed: version in force from 19 October 2026 and tax treatment of the reward (invoice, VAT under the reverse charge, Romanian withholding tax and certificate of tax residence)
A money reward is paid only after the documents are checked; credit on the subscription still needs no documents
Email in 6 languages saying what to send; on the Invite & save page the reward shows «Documents to send»
Privacy policy updated with the invite programme data; translations aligned

changelog.title: Product page as a story, more reliable demo
items: Site: the Product page tells a story, from the customer asking for a price at 10 pm to the complete request reaching you
"See OneSpec in action" with real screens step by step and the list of what the customer can choose
"The dashboard where you control everything" with the platform's real screen, in every language
Showroom configurator on the Demo page only; repeated sections removed from the site
Platform demo: requests open, the overview shows widget opens, the period selector is translated in every language
New «Legal notice» page with CORE829 SRL's details and director, linked in the footer
Legal documents translated into English, French, German, Dutch and Romanian (the Italian text prevails); privacy policy updated with country and date of birth

changelog.title: Cookie and privacy banner on the site
items: Site: cookie and privacy banner on the first visit, with equal “Accept” and “Reject” and “Customise” by category
Cookie-free visit statistics start only after consent, on the site and in the platform; change your choice any time from “Cookie preferences”
Updated cookie policy: language cookie, visit statistics and how the choice is stored

changelog.title: A steady demo and a more faithful home page
items: Demo: fixed the constant flicker of the dashboard, especially on phones
Home: the requests section now shows the platform's real Requests page, with filters, statuses and actions
Platform in German, Dutch and Romanian: translated the last texts still in English (request statuses, notifications)

changelog.title: Guided path in customer widgets too
items: The 3-step guided configurator is now available in every widget: visitors switch between “Guided” and “Full” with one tap
Dealers choose what shows first: just add data-mode="guided" to the embed script (or ?mode=guided to the link)
Cleaner visit statistics: demo pages and embedded widgets are not counted, and links carrying secret codes are not recorded

changelog.title: Guided demo, a simpler home page and a compact menu
items: The demo configurator is now guided in 3 steps (type and size, openings and glass, profile and finish), with the drawing and the price always in view; the full mode is still there
Showroom: a detailed customer quote, with a line per piece, discount, VAT, deposit and balance, instalment and terms
A simpler home page: an essential hero, prices on the dedicated page, and the presentation film only on the Italian site
Compact top menu that stays visible, with the TikTok and Instagram icons
Demo: fixed the loading that could stay stuck, and a much faster start

changelog.title: About us, company contacts and a clearer homepage
items: New “About us” page: OneSpec is made by window installers for window installers, with the problem it solves, the founders and CORE829 SRL’s company details
Footer with CORE829 SRL’s registered office, tax ID and trade register number, the founders’ phone numbers, WhatsApp and the support, office and sales emails
Homepage: badge and logo readable on any background, TikTok and Instagram links and a continuously scrolling strip showing what OneSpec really does
Platform: Enterprise plan requests go to hello@onespec.eu and the legal pages show CORE829 SRL’s details and contacts

changelog.title: Payments: reactivating an expired plan always works
items: Customers who cancelled can subscribe again without errors: the payment page opens even if the previous billing details are no longer valid
After payment the plan is reactivated immediately and an old, closed subscription can no longer suspend it
Clear messages if the payment service is temporarily unavailable

changelog.title: Start screen: more room under the cube
items: The turning cube no longer touches the message below it

changelog.title: The start screen now shows on every opening
items: The OneSpec cube with the 8-second bar now appears every time you open the platform, not only the first time in a session
It does not come back while you move between pages inside the platform

changelog.title: New start screen with the OneSpec cube
items: When the platform opens, the OneSpec cube appears with an 8-second loading bar and changing messages ("Setting up your platform")
Shown once per session: reopening the page in the same session goes straight in

changelog.title: Phone: buttons and links easier to tap
items: Links, filters and small buttons have a larger touch area (up to 44 px) without changing how the page looks
Scrolling filter chips (requests, notifications) are slightly taller for a sure tap
New accessibility scan: zero issues on phone and desktop

changelog.title: Accessibility and readability: full platform check
items: Toggles, dropdowns and number fields now have names that screen readers can read; the closed mobile menu can no longer be reached with Tab
Better colour contrast in the light theme (secondary text, green and error red) and headings in the correct order on every page
Scrollable tables reachable by keyboard; larger close button on the mobile menu

changelog.title: Fluid loading across the platform and a reworked drag and drop
items: Every page rises in from below and loading shows skeletons with a wave of light, shaped like the real content: no jumps
Dashboard with floating cards and counting numbers; elastic switches and buttons; dialogs grow out of the spot you pressed
Drag and drop rebuilt in Deals and Work sites: the card lifts, follows your finger or mouse and settles with a spring; it works on phones and empty columns now accept cards
In the demo, the “Show me how” button moves a cursor and drags a card for you
Everything switches off when “reduce motion” is on in your device

changelog.title: Two-step verification with an authenticator app
items: Turn on two-step verification from the Account page (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…): besides your password you need a one-time code
Ten one-time recovery codes in case you lose your phone; the code is also required to reset your password
Encrypted secret, codes usable only once and a lock after five wrong attempts

changelog.title: Protected attachments: security scan, signature and signed download
items: Every ticket attachment is automatically checked (harmful content, file structure) and signed; suspicious files are rejected
Downloads use a temporary HTTPS link with security headers and an integrity signature; the team can verify the integrity of any file
Your data export now also includes the internal notes of your tickets; legal texts updated (portability, security checks)

changelog.title: Privacy and support: data export, erasure, “Contact us” replies
items: Support tickets and messages sent from the “Contact us” page are now included in your data export (JSON) and are deleted together with your account
Privacy notice, GDPR rights, terms of service and cookie texts updated: support retention periods, roles, providers and supervisory authority (ANSPDCP)
The team can answer “Contact us” messages directly from the platform and see the daily trend and per-agent statistics; search also finds by company name

changelog.title: Statistics and search for the support team
items: The team now has support statistics (first-response times, target compliance, time to resolve, average rating) over 7, 30 or 90 days
In the ticket queue you can search by number, subject or words in a message and filter by category, so any request is found in seconds

changelog.title: Quick replies and overdue alerts for the team
items: The support team now has ready-made reply templates to insert and edit before sending: answers are faster and more consistent
If a ticket gets no first reply within its target, the team is alerted automatically (once per ticket) with a notification and an email

changelog.title: “Support” link on the website
items: A “Support” link now appears in the website footer: it opens the platform's “Contact us” page in your language, useful also for people who cannot sign in

changelog.title: Unread-reply badge and “Contact us” page
items: A counter (a dot on phones) appears on the “Support” menu when the team has replied to one of your tickets and you have not read it yet
New “Contact us” page reachable from the sign-in screen: people who cannot sign in can write to the team without an account, with anti-spam protection
Messages arrive in an inbox reserved for the team and are deleted after a limited period

changelog.title: Tickets: email and attachments
items: When the team replies or resolves a ticket you also get an email, in your language; the email never contains the message text, only the ticket number and a link to open it
You can attach up to 3 files per message (PNG, JPG, WebP images or PDF, 8 MB max): every file is checked by the server before it is accepted
Files are visible only to those who can see the ticket and open through a temporary link

changelog.title: Support ticket system
items: New «Support» section in the platform: open a ticket by category, follow the conversation with the OneSpec team, reply, close and rate the support
Each ticket is visible only to its author and to your company's managers; the team's internal notes are never visible to the customer
The team works from a queue with priority, assignment and a first-response target; replies also arrive as a notification
Available in Italian, English, French, German, Dutch and Romanian

changelog.title: Version in the menu and a steadier phone experience
items: The product version now appears in the side menu (and in the “More” sheet on phones) next to your plan, identical to the one on this page and updated automatically with every release
Phone: text fields no longer trigger automatic zoom on iPhone and no page drifts sideways; the widget grid and the chart tooltips are fixed and now always stay on screen
Security: the web framework (Next.js) is updated to a patched release, on both the platform and the website

changelog.title: Complete platform demo
items: New Demo page: the whole platform (dashboard, quotes, clients, job sites, leads, requests, supply, surveys, configurators, statistics) with sample data, straight from the website
Works on desktop, tablet and phone; it also opens full screen and you can start over at any time
Runs in your browser: nothing is sent; payments, external checks and real sending are turned off with a clear message
Fixed a missing label on the Job sites page (drag handle)

changelog.title: Bicolour and configurators that fit every phone
items: Bicolour: pick one finish for the outside and another for the inside, priced (average of the two finishes plus a per-m² surcharge you set) in the widget, wizard, Showroom, B2B quote, PDF and exports
The drawing shows the inside or the outside face in the right colour
Widget and single-page configurator centred and aligned on phones; the simple wizard has proper margins and easy-to-tap buttons

changelog.title: Complete and safer sign-up
items: Sign up in one step: personal details, date of birth (adult check), company data and signing of the data processing agreement (DPA) without going through the profile
Show/hide password, checks on every field and stronger passwords on sign-up, login and recovery
Email delivery and bounce notifications are recorded correctly, without duplicates
Safer email sending and admin resends are logged

changelog.title: Leads and the customer's document folder
items: Leads page: import lists from Excel (.xlsx), CSV and Word (.docx); columns are recognised automatically and you can correct them before importing
From the list, add a lead as a customer or link it to a site, even in bulk
Upload final quotes as PDF: they stay in the customer's folder, linked to the site and the internal quote
Every file upload is checked on its real content and protected against abuse

changelog.title: Phone and tablet: more room and gestures
items: No more top bar on phones and tablets: only the bottom island remains, with safe margins for the notch and system bar
Swipe gestures: close menus and sheets by dragging, open the side menu from the edge
"More" menu with light/dark theme, installing the app on the Home screen, language, account, notifications, plan and service status
Buttons on the Configurators page always stay inside the screen

changelog.title: Phone app, automated tests and better menus
items: iPhone-style bottom island with the main pages and an "Add to Home Screen" button on every browser
Dropdown menus and controls in the onespec colours with smooth animations that respect the reduce-motion setting
Automatic browser test of 27 platform pages, from the quote to signature and PDF
Fix: drawing dimensions can be edited with one click again

changelog.title: Teams, drafts and automatic links
items: Teams with a password: colleagues join with a link, one-time code and password, without registering; professional grades
Draft quotes you can edit and delete; the customer and the site are created automatically from the quote, without duplicates
Digital signature fixed (white on dark, black on light) and empty signatures refused; PDF viewable and downloadable on a phone
Horizontal bars and linked panels (L and U shapes) in the drawing, with a different bar for each leaf
Security: nonce-based content policy and stricter checks on quote access

changelog.title: Standard price list, fitting and supply
items: Standard price list by zone (North, Centre, South) and margin with a slider and decimals; prices exclude VAT, with intra-EU 0% VAT checked against VIES
Optional fitting at a per-m² price: with fitting or supply only, also with your own transporter and fitter
Supply: partners that produce or deliver, Quote → Order → Production → Delivery flow, export for the accountant and net profit by period
10-step onboarding with per-country checks on VAT number, postcode and phone; quality, profile and glazing always compatible
Leaf dimensions edited directly on the drawing

changelog.title: Technical drawings, glazing and professional finishes
items: Complete technical drawings: inside/outside elevation, plan, section, hardware, installation detail and survey sheet
Technical rules for leaves: fixed or movable mullion, handle always on the active leaf
Double (24–28 mm) and triple (32–52 mm) glazing packages with the compositions recommended by height
Nearly 200 colours and decors with swatch preview: realistic textures on the frame, RAL and stone effect

changelog.title: Safer payments and access
items: Direct sign-up: pick a plan and pay with Stripe before entering
Cancelling during the trial stops access immediately; one free trial per card
When a subscription ends the platform locks, and reactivates when you subscribe again
Automatic check of subscription status with Stripe

changelog.title: Errors, data and copy aligned
items: Error and «not found» pages in six languages
Stricter checks on submitted data and uploaded files
Enterprise with no request limit
Plans and features described only for what is really available

changelog.title: Level 1, 2 and 3 plans
items: Quote tool on your website and link page for social media, from €49.95 per month
Showroom quote tool, white-label and site logistics in Level 2 and 3
Clear monthly limits on requests, PDFs and WhatsApp sends

changelog.title: Six languages, six markets
items: Italian, English, French, German, Dutch and Romanian
VAT, rules and incentives correct for Italy, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and Luxembourg
Emails, PDFs and public pages in your customer's language

changelog.title: Launch audit
items: Security checks and limits designed for thousands of users
Account deletion on request, as required by the GDPR
Protection against spam and abuse on the public widget

changelog.title: Logistics and guided configurator
items: Logistics module: suppliers, carriers, deliveries, calendar and stock
Guided procedure to create your first configurator
Setup guide always at hand

changelog.title: Editor, permissions and subscriptions
items: Cancellation and plan change with prorated calculation
Permissions by role and by plan
Live preview and auto-save in the configurator editor
Anti-bot protection on sign-up and the widget

hero.title: It's 10 pm. A customer asks how much six windows cost.
hero.subtitle: You're still on site, the price list is at the office and tomorrow you have three surveys. By the time you can answer, they have already asked someone else. OneSpec changes the ending: your website gives them the price, right away, from your own price list.

problem.title: The problem isn't the customer. It's everything that happens before the quote.

items.title: Quotes get done in the evening
items.body: Sizes, materials, glazing, VAT: every request is a sum to redo by hand after work. And the longer the customer waits, the colder they get.

items.title: Lots of calls, few customers
items.body: Browsers with no budget, site surveys for sizes the customer hasn't decided yet. Your hours, paid by no one.

items.title: Your price ends up in the wrong hands
items.body: Someone who asks for a quote only to pass it to a competitor takes your work for free, and you never know.

setup.title: From your price list to your website in four steps
setup.subtitle: No development: you prepare the configurator in the platform and paste it into your website.

blocks.title: 1. Import your price list
blocks.description: Upload a CSV file with materials, glazing, finishes and hardware with their prices, then complete sizes and pricing rules from the platform, without retyping everything by hand.

blocks.title: 2. Brand the widget
blocks.description: Choose colors, fonts, logo and copy for the configurator from the platform. The result is a widget that looks built specifically for your site, not an external plugin.

blocks.title: 3. Paste the iFrame code
blocks.description: A single snippet to paste on your site's page. The configurator is responsive by default: designed for mobile and desktop, not just adapted.

blocks.title: 4. Always update from the platform
blocks.description: Change prices, add products or edit discount rules from the onespec dashboard. Changes go live on every site where the widget is installed, without touching the client's code.

hero.subtitle: You receive 10% of its subscription price (VAT excluded), as credit or as money in your Stripe account. It gets 10% off its first payment.

steps.title: Share your link
steps.description: From the platform you get a personal code and link to send to another company in the window industry.

steps.title: The company signs up and picks a plan
steps.description: Its 10% discount is applied automatically to the first payment, with no code to enter.

steps.title: You receive the reward
steps.description: After the first payment and 30 days without refunds, you receive 10% of the plan price, VAT excluded: as credit on your subscription or as money in your Stripe account.

referralPage.amountsNote: The reward is 10% of the list price of the plan chosen by the invited company, VAT excluded, once per company.
referralPage.annualNote: With yearly billing (where available) reward and discount are 10% of the yearly price. Prices exclude VAT. The Enterprise plan is agreed with us.
rules: Owners and admins of an account with an active subscription can invite.
The reward matures after the invited company's first real payment and 30 days without refunds or disputes.
At most 10 rewards every 12 months per account.
Invitations between accounts of the same person or company, or using the same payment card, do not earn a reward.

A money reward is the payment for a referral service: to receive it you send your invoice to CORE829 SRL and, if your company is not based in Romania, its certificate of tax residence. Credit on your subscription needs no documents. Details in the programme rules.

aboutPage.metaDescription: OneSpec is built by window installers for window installers: a digital product of CORE829 SRL that brings configurator, quotes, customers and job sites into one place.

hero.title: Built by window installers, for window installers
hero.subtitle: OneSpec comes from everyday work in the window and door trade: site surveys, measurements, price lists, quotes and job sites. We built it to give installers back the hours they now spend between spreadsheets and the phone.

aboutPage.painTitle: The problem we saw up close
aboutPage.painIntro: Anyone who installs windows knows this struggle: before earning anything, time is lost in steps nobody pays for.

pains.title: Quotes that go nowhere
pains.text: Hours of measuring, calculating and calling for a quote that often never becomes an order.

pains.title: The price comes last
pains.text: Customers only find out the price after the survey and the quote: those over budget realise it when the time is already spent.

pains.title: Everything scattered across spreadsheets and chats
pains.text: Price lists, customers, job sites and supplies live in different files and chats: the same data gets retyped again and again.

pains.title: A website that doesn't work for you
pains.text: The company site shows photos and a contact form, but doesn't help customers understand what they want and what it costs.

aboutPage.solutionIntro: Two tools that work together. Use one or both, depending on how your company is organised.

solutions.title: The configurator on your website
solutions.text: It goes on your website with one line of code, with your colours and your logo. Customers choose sizes, colours and glass, see the price and send you a complete request.
points: Price calculated on your price list
Requests with sizes, choices and contacts
Spam filter and sorting by value

solutions.title: Your whole company in one place
solutions.text: Quotes with technical drawings and digital signature, customers, job sites, surveys, supply, logistics and acceptance tests: all connected, from request to installation.
points: Quote with technical drawing and PDF
Customers, job sites and supplies linked

how.title: From the job site to the code
how.text: Every feature starts from a real problem in an installer's work, not from a wish list.

how.title: Continuous improvements
how.text: We ship updates all the time and publish them on the Changelog page, with date and details.

how.title: Talk to the people who build it
how.text: Support is built into the platform and the team that develops OneSpec answers you.

how.title: Designed for Europe
how.text: Six languages and pricing rules for Italy, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and Luxembourg.
